description.from:
## Behavior
As an author, I can apply cinematic transitions between scenes that continue animating.

## Acceptance scenarios
Given overlapping animated scenes, when a transition is evaluated at a frame, then both scenes use the correct local time and the shader receives deterministic progress. Initial examples include domain warp, chromatic split, cinematic zoom, and light leak; the inventory tracks the remaining upstream shader set. Start/end boundaries and non-overlap behavior are specified.

## Ownership
stdlib, toolchain, player

## Evidence
Link implementation, runnable fixtures, and verification results before closing. Keep product-boundary decisions in the parent initiative.
